topography.project_purpose: Cross Chain Bridge. Structurally: 94 project-authored contract(s) across 10 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 25 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 3 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (owned, strategyrole, ownerpausableupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
